about_the_game:
Play as Ester or Sye, seeing 2 different perspectives of Eastwynne. How they react and, conversely, how the world reacts to them.  Similarly to our irl Earth, this society is abundant with culture, history, and magic.

Your actions will affect the course of the story, what you learn, what you can accomplish, and who chooses to stand beside you.

If the pressure of decision-making is getting to you, there are difficulty options that will give you hints about major choices and decrease the difficulty of dice rolls and battles. Or you can live life on the edge and have no consequence warnings at all...

Magic flows everywhere. Develop skills and learn new spells, leading towards specific specializations that can aid you both in exploration and beyond. Learn what works and doesn't, what you can counter, and what you're weak against. Magic doesn't always equate to violence, but sometimes it does​.

❖ Features ❖

  • Branching Storylines: Influence the paths that should be taken and change the narrative. Be warned, your actions have consequences.

  • Friends, Foes, and Everything in Between: It's a big world with many characters. Will you make friends or foes? Who knows whether they like you or not may have nothing to do with your actions.

  • Magic and Battles: Learn new skills and spells through lessons and other sources. Apply what you've learned while exploring and in combat.

  • Voiced in English featuring a super amazing cast 💖

content_descriptors.notes: Content Warnings: Social issues/sensitive topics, mild to strong violence, mild to strong language, and other mature themes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft Windows 8.1
  • Processor: Intel i5-4690K (4th Gen) or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPUs with at least 4GB of VRAM: GTX 1050 Ti, GTX 980 or Radeon RX 570
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-10400 (10th Gen) or Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPUs with at least 6GB of VRAM or higher: RTX 2060 or Radeon RX 5600
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: A CRPG set in the grandiose city of Eastwynne, where magic is commonplace. Follow the stories of a group of university students; how will your choices alter their lives?
